records.name: Herr Federmaß
records.biography_en: Federmaß keeps a HyperNorm doorway under the protection of his round shield. A card proposing that firmness can include doubt receives his slowest stare: a position is either held or lost. Men in Black praise his composure. He has left the arrow in his own shield because removing evidence would look less authoritative.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Standpunkt hält. Die Ursache steckt noch darin.

variant_notes.note_en: He confuses a calm expression with a settled argument.

records.name: Vera Sehnenruh
records.biography_en: Vera measures every disagreement against an imaginary straight line through her HyperNorm window. A card suggesting that intention and outcome can diverge must be badly aimed. Hunky & Dory admire her precision and keep moving the target. She carries the blunt arrow separately, preserving one small interval in which she can still reconsider.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zielsetzung ist abgeschlossen. Das Ziel wurde inzwischen versetzt.

variant_notes.note_en: She has perfected her aim and would now like circumstances to hold still.

records.name: Herr Raschelverdacht
records.biography_en: Raschelverdacht guards the quietest HyperNorm stairwell with a spear he finds reassuringly substantial. Silence is safe or suspicious, depending on the preceding sound. A card allowing uncertainty makes both categories tremble. Men in Black expect vigilance, so he reports the rustle before checking whether it came from his own scarf.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Geräusch wurde vorsorglich als anwesend gemeldet.

variant_notes.note_en: He is certain something moved and hopes it was somebody authorised.

records.name: Bummbert Auftakt
records.biography_en: Bummbert supplies the HyperNorm residents with a shared beat before asking whether they want one. A card proposing that solidarity can tolerate different rhythms receives another tremendous opening flourish. Hunky & Dory encourage participation. He is delighted whenever somebody joins in, and has difficulty distinguishing that event from somebody asking him to stop.

variant_notes.note_en: He mistakes an enthusiastic beginning for general agreement.

records.name: Frau Kantenruhe
records.biography_en: Kantenruhe rests a hand on her broad stone hatchet while the HyperNorm corridor meeting revisits its opening motion. A disagreement is finished or unnecessary, according to her private rule. A card suggesting that patience may contain resistance stays near her door. Men in Black read her silence as cooperation; she has not confirmed their reading.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Wortmeldung liegt seit geraumer Zeit schwer in der Hand.

variant_notes.note_en: She can wait longer than most arguments remain persuasive.

records.name: Otto Rückstoß
records.biography_en: Otto defends the dignity of a HyperNorm landing with a worn hat and an old musket kept upright beside him. A card suggesting that authority may be quiet provokes his loudest correction. Hunky & Dory call him dependable. Between outbursts he carefully straightens the drooping feather, a task that accepts no verbal solution.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Einwand ist vollständig. Der Anlass wird nachgereicht.

variant_notes.note_en: His objection arrives at full volume before its subject has been established.
